title: Secondary CTA · filled pill (vertical-themed)
description: Secondary CTA paired with primary. Fully filled pill — background is a 90° dark gradient that re-themes per vertical via --cta-secondary-fill (snow-removal: bronze/olive; lawn-care: dark green; hvac: dark amber; etc). Light text, 1 px soft border, always-on soft halo that strengthens on hover, sparkle icon that rotates 180° on hover. Inner bottom hover-rise comes from effect.hover-rise. No rainbow ring — explicitly a different visual primitive than primary so the pair reads as two distinct affordances.

source.secondary: servicewand.com pair pattern (primary + secondary on hero)
source.harmonized: PM lock 2026-05-22 — replaces cta.btn-secondary-ghost. Secondary is filled, not outlined.

notes: Vertical-themed via tokens: set <body data-vertical="lawn-care"> on the page and the secondary background, halo, and accent shift together.
Always-on halo uses --cta-accent-soft (low alpha). On hover the halo switches to --cta-accent (full color) — the same accent that tints the primary's outer hover glow, so the pair feels cohesive.
Re-declares the base .btn geometry inline so the block works standalone — when paired with cta.btn-primary-ring, the second copy of those rules is harmless (specificity equal, identical values).
::before is explicitly nullified (content: none + background: none) in case markup includes both .btn-primary-ring and .btn-secondary-filled on the same element by accident.
